opening.argument: The description promises a free $1,000 Victoria's Secret gift card and sends viewers to an external site to pursue it. The offer is presented as available after completion of program requirements, while the screen asks for an email address and provides a Continue button. Those requirements are not specified in the supplied material. Ordinary Victoria's Secret product and gift-card advertising provides promotional context, but does not establish authorization for this separate $1,000 offer. The combination of a free, high-value reward claim, an external destination, and an email-entry step supports treating the offer as a low-barrier reward solicitation without assuming that anyone lost money or received a card.
